description: “When it comes to healthcare access, our veterans who bravely served our country deserve to be first in line. Our veterans made the sacrifice, we owe them our gratitude and we must continue to provide them services when they return home. As a former aide to congressman Lane Evans, I’ve always known the importance of putting our veterans first. My sincere thanks go to the City of Galesburg and the Department of Veterans Affairs for expanding this important clinic and for keeping Lane’s legacy alive in western Illinois."
title: Halpin applauds Lane Evans VA expansion in Galesburg - Mike Halpin for Illinois
